versions.changelog: Fix missing images in Xiaolushu image notes by supporting picture_page_info_list in both assignment (=) and object-property (:) syntax. Preserve image order and substantive full-article content.

Prevent normal long articles from being misclassified as image notes when picture_page_info_list is present; recover full structured body text from #js_content/content_noencode; preserve Xiaolüshu text plus ordered multi-image output; strengthen JSON completeness verification guidance.
Preserve image-note/Xiaolüshu body text from page metadata; decode escaped line breaks into Markdown paragraphs before ordered images; add body_text_length to JSON verification output.
Republish the hardened 1.1 artifact after checking ClawHub verification metadata. No runtime changes from 1.1.0.

Add WeChat image-note/Xiaolüshu multi-image archiving; support saved page source via --html-file and configurable image timeouts; replace fetched-page JavaScript execution with static metadata parsing; enforce strict WeChat host and redirect validation; improve date and account extraction; remove deprecated request-promise dependency.
